column2: Yeah, someday...{wait}{clear}It'll take a long time, though. I'm sure of it.{wait}{clear}
I'm sure you can do it, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
You think?{wait}{clear}Someone like me could never pull it off...{wait}{clear}
Well, still, I'd like to do something, even if it's just a little.{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Sorry for calling you out of the blue.{wait}{clear}
So, I got a letter from my brother. He's summoned me. To the palace.{wait}{clear}
Mind if I go?{wait}{clear}
I don't mind{n}
Yes, I don't mind at all.{wait}{clear}
Really? Thanks.{wait}{clear}
What does he say?{n}
What is he like?{n}
What does your brother say?{wait}{clear}
Hm...? Oh, just that there's something he wants me to do for him...{wait}{clear}
I'll hear the details when I see him.{wait}{clear}
What is your brother like?{wait}{clear}
Huh? You don't know anything about my brother?{wait}{clear}
He's Hugues Legrance, the young king who'll carry Legrance into the next age.{wait}{clear}
He'd make a far better world-saving hero, as you put it, than I ever would.{wait}{clear}
Not that my brother the king would ever go off with you, though...{wait}{clear}
Anyway, he's amazing. I can't hold a candle to him at anything.{wait}{clear}
Meet him once and you'll see. You too.{wait}{clear}
...Could you put the mission first for now?{wait}{clear}
Something could happen at any moment... Could you put this first for now?{wait}{clear}
What the heck?{wait}{clear}
I told you because I thought it'd be rude to just leave without a word...{wait}{clear}
Sorry, but I'm going. It's my brother asking. I can't just ignore him.{wait}{clear}
Your Majesty, Rudiere has arrived. How may I serve you?{wait}{clear}
Hugues
Ha ha, enough joking. There's no one else here. Talk to me as you always do.{wait}{clear}
...All right, I'll do that.{wait}{clear}So, brother, what's this about? Calling for me like this... did something happen?{wait}{clear}
Now, don't be so hasty. Let's take our time. It's been a while since we've seen each other.{wait}{clear}More to the point, I hear you're traveling these days, Rudi?{wait}{clear}
Yeah... with a friend. I got invited along...{wait}{clear}
You certainly seem to be getting around. My messengers were at their wits' end.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I go all over. My friend's got a lot of demands.{wait}{clear}Go here, that place is good, no, north, wait, south... I'm getting dragged all over.{wait}{clear}
I see. But it sounds like fun, doesn't it?{wait}{clear}
